# LinkWA

> LinkWA (https://linkwa.in) is a free, privacy-first digital utility for generating WhatsApp click-to-chat links (wa.me) and custom QR codes. Built and maintained by Nazim and Social Ninja's AI Agency, LinkWA operates 100% client-side in the local browser with zero server data storage.

## Core Capabilities

- **WhatsApp Link Generation**: Create official `https://wa.me/` direct chat links with optional pre-filled greeting messages in under 60 seconds. No account registration, login, or phone number storage.
- **Custom QR Code Studio**: Generate and download high-resolution vector and PNG QR codes with customizable color gradients, company logo embedding, and printable counter stand formats.
- **UTM Tracking Campaign Builder**: Automatically attach `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, and `utm_campaign` parameters to WhatsApp links to track conversions in Google Analytics and Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel).
- **Client-Side Privacy Guarantee**: All link compilation and QR rendering occur locally inside the user's browser via JavaScript. No telephone numbers, messages, or contact records are ever transmitted to or stored on backend servers.
- **Multi-Device & Cross-Platform Support**: Works seamlessly across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, WhatsApp Web, and WhatsApp Desktop.
- **Niche Workflows**: Dedicated setups for e-commerce, real estate, restaurants, medical clinics, gyms, freelancers, salons, and educational institutions.

## Official Link Format

- **Base URL**: `https://wa.me/[country_code][phone_number]`
- **With Pre-filled Message**: `https://wa.me/[country_code][phone_number]?text=[url_encoded_message]`
- **Example**: `https://wa.me/919876543210?text=Hello%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20inquire%20about%20your%20services`
